title.zh: 肱骨扭转、提携角和肘屈伸轴
title.en: Humeral torsion, carrying angle and the elbow flexion axis

method.zh: 由肱骨网格和骨架的关节量出：肱骨头中心取盂肱关节中心（构建骨架时对关节面的球拟合）；骨干轴取肱骨中段顶点的主方向；内外上髁取远端 12% 顶点在垂直骨干平面内最宽方向上的两个极点。后倾角 = 垂直骨干的平面内，“骨干轴 → 肱骨头中心”的方向相对“指向内侧的上髁连线”的夹角，肱骨头偏后为正（即后倾，文献中的常规）。提携角 = 肱骨冠状面（骨干轴与上髁连线张成）内，肘关节中心 → 腕关节中心的方向相对骨干轴向外偏的角；量的是静止姿势（肘约屈 12°、前臂旋后），不是完全伸直。肘屈伸轴取骨架的 elbow 关节的 axes[0]。
method.en: Measured from the humerus mesh and the rig's joints: the head centre is the glenohumeral joint centre (a sphere fitted to the articular surface when the rig was built); the shaft axis is the principal direction of the mid-shaft vertices; the epicondyles are the two extreme points, along the widest direction across the shaft, of the vertices in the distal 12 %. Retroversion = in the plane across the shaft, the angle of the direction "shaft axis → head centre" against the medially pointing epicondylar line, positive when the head lies posterior (retroversion, the usual convention). Carrying angle = in the coronal plane of the humerus (spanned by shaft axis and epicondylar line), the lateral deviation of the direction elbow centre → wrist centre from the shaft axis; it is measured in the rest pose (elbow about 12° flexed, forearm supinated), not in full extension. The elbow flexion axis is axes[0] of the rig's elbow joint.

tolerance.zh: 每行的 band 写明区间的来历；有均值和标准差的取 ± 2 SD。没有可核对的个体范围或配对差标准差时记为 not comparable，并说明原因。
tolerance.en: Every row's `band` says where its interval comes from; mean ± 2 SD where a mean and SD exist. Where no verifiable range of individuals or SD of a paired difference exists the row is "not comparable", with the reason.

notes.zh: 骨的网格很粗（每根肱骨约 650 个三角形），上髁极点和骨干轴各有约 2–3° 的不确定度；女性的右前臂和右手是左侧的镜像，她的右侧提携角因此不是独立的测量。
notes.en: The bone meshes are coarse (about 650 triangles per humerus), so the epicondylar points and the shaft axis each carry an uncertainty of about 2–3°; the female's right forearm and hand are a mirrored left, so her right carrying angle is not an independent measurement.

notes.zh: SKEL（skel.is.tue.mpg.de）没有使用：它的许可是“仅限非商业科学研究”的单用户许可，下载即视为接受条款并需要注册；条款写明数据和软件“不得复制、修改或以任何形式提供给第三方”。本项目是公开仓库、不能代用户接受协议，所以没有下载。
notes.en: SKEL (skel.is.tue.mpg.de) was not used: its licence is a single-user licence "for non-commercial scientific research purposes", accepted by downloading and requiring registration, and it states that the data and software may not be "reproduced, modified and/or made available in any form to any third party". This is a public repository and no agreement may be accepted on the user's behalf, so nothing was downloaded.

summary.male_L: retroversion 29.3° (vs flexion axis 30.8°), carrying 1.4° (ulna axis -1.8°), axis-to-shaft 90.7°, axis-to-epicondylar 1.7°, epicondylar width 63.7 mm
summary.male_R: retroversion 40.1° (vs flexion axis 41.2°), carrying -0.7° (ulna axis -3.6°), axis-to-shaft 90.1°, axis-to-epicondylar 1.1°, epicondylar width 63.6 mm
summary.female_L: retroversion 22.9° (vs flexion axis 36.1°), carrying 8.4° (ulna axis 2.8°), axis-to-shaft 93.2°, axis-to-epicondylar 13.5°, epicondylar width 55 mm
summary.female_R: retroversion 5.1° (vs flexion axis 10.7°), carrying 8.8° (ulna axis 3.8°), axis-to-shaft 92.4°, axis-to-epicondylar 6.1°, epicondylar width 44.2 mm

rows.quantity: humeral head retroversion against the epicondylar line
rows.band: range of the mean values reported for healthy humeri (12°–36°), not a range of individuals
rows.quote: Oswald 2026: "reported mean healthy humeral torsion values vary widely (range, 12° to 36°)"; Boileau 2008 (abstract): "The retroversion with respect to the transepicondylar axis was 17.9°"

rows.quantity: carrying angle (forearm axis against humeral shaft, coronal plane of the humerus)
rows.quote: In males, the mean carrying angle of the right elbow was found to be 12.55 ± 2.3° and of the left was found to be 12.27 ± 2.43°, while in females, the mean carrying angle of the right elbow was found to be 14.53 ± 2.34° and 14.06 ± 3.37° in the left

rows.quantity: elbow flexion axis against humeral shaft axis
rows.quote: HAA (°) 86.22 ± 3.27 (angle formed by the humeral shaft axis and the flexion axis of the distal humerus on the radial side in the coronal plane); Right 85.41 ± 3.07°, Left 86.88 ± 3.31°

note.zh: 参照的角在冠状面内、取桡侧；我们的是三维夹角折到 0–90°，所以只在偏离垂直的大小上可比。
note.en: The reference angle is taken in the coronal plane on the radial side; ours is the 3D angle folded to 0–90°, so only the amount off perpendicular is comparable.

rows.quantity: humeral head retroversion against the epicondylar line
rows.band: range of the mean values reported for healthy humeri (12°–36°), not a range of individuals
rows.quote: Oswald 2026: "reported mean healthy humeral torsion values vary widely (range, 12° to 36°)"; Boileau 2008 (abstract): "The retroversion with respect to the transepicondylar axis was 17.9°"

note.zh: 落在已发表“均值”的范围之外；个体的正常范围更宽，但没有能逐字核对的公开数值（Boileau 2008 全文里的标准差 13.7°、范围 −6.7° 到 47.5° 只经摘要模型转述，未逐字核对）。负值表示肱骨头指向内外上髁连线的前方，即前倾。是否异常请看左右差那一行。
note.en: Outside the range of published means; the normal range of individuals is wider, but no openly verifiable figure for it was found (the SD of 13.7° and the range −6.7° to 47.5° in the full text of Boileau 2008 were only relayed by a summarising model and not checked verbatim). A negative value means the head points anterior of the epicondylar line, i.e. anteversion. For abnormality see the left-minus-right row.

rows.quantity: side difference of humeral head retroversion
rows.band: mean + 2 SD of the absolute bilateral difference (6.9° ± 5.3°)
rows.quote: Oswald 2026: "the previously reported mean bilateral difference in torsion of 6.9° ± 5.3°" (cited to an earlier 3D-CT study that was not opened); Boileau 2008 (abstract): "The difference between the right and left humeri was 8.9°."

rows.band: difference of the group means only; no paired SD in an open source
rows.quote: In males, the mean carrying angle of the right elbow was found to be 12.55 ± 2.3° and of the left was found to be 12.27 ± 2.43°, while in females, the mean carrying angle of the right elbow was found to be 14.53 ± 2.34° and 14.06 ± 3.37° in the left

note.zh: 公开来源里没有同一人左右差的标准差，只有两侧均值相差不到 0.5°。
note.en: No open source gives the SD of the within-person side difference; the two group means differ by less than 0.5°.

rows.quantity: angle between the left and right elbow flexion axes, each expressed in its own humerus frame
rows.band: difference of unpaired group means in one plane (86.88° left vs 85.41° right); no paired SD in an open source

note.zh: 参照只有不同人的左、右两组均值之差（一个平面内 1.5°）。另一篇打开过的尸体研究（Schwarz 等 2025，PMC12222642）报告屈伸轴的轴向旋转左右高度相关（r = 0.906）、两侧均值 12.8° 和 13.4°，同样没有配对差的标准差。
note.en: The reference offers only the difference between group means of different people (1.5° in one plane). Another opened cadaver study (Schwarz et al. 2025, PMC12222642) reports that the axial rotation of the flexion axis is highly correlated between sides (r = 0.906) with side means of 12.8° and 13.4°, again without an SD of the paired difference.
